hook: IIM Bangalore: all *608* students got summer internship offers
hook_b: ₹2 lakh stipend for a summer internship? IIM-B's *2026* numbers
tldr: IIM Bangalore reports 100% summer placement: 608 PGP and PGP-BA students got offers in Oct 26–29 recruiting.

beats.what: IIM Bangalore completed summer placements for 608 students with 100% offers.
beats.why: Recruiting ran Oct 26–29 for the PGP and PGP in Business Analytics batches.
beats.care: Eyeing CAT or an MBA? These are the internship numbers top B-schools now report.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: All 608 students in the Post Graduate Programme in Management and PGP in Business Analytics secured summer offers. The process ran Oct 26–29. NDTV Profit's headline puts the median stipend at ₹2 lakh (its web link says average). Recruiter names and sector split were not in the summary we read.

cards.title: 📅 Speed
cards.body: Four days of recruiting, Oct 26–29, for the full batch.
